prompt: Generate this: # 101  **Astara the Titanic Dragon** (The Mother of Stars)  ## Creation  When the first [[dragons]] were created, [[The Forge Titan]] was extremely intrigued that the [[gods]] were able to do this, and he followed their "recipe" and created his own two dragons. They became known as the [[Titanic dragons]]. They had very unique properties, were hard to understand, acted weird, but were generally loved for their infinite curiosity.  [[Berry]] and Astara were created as siblings by the titan.  ## Description  Astara is viewed as [[Berry]]'s older sister, as she is more stern, less curious and more wary.  She is the name mother for the stars, as her scales are pitch black with glowing spots that seem to be "inside" the scales - basically she looks like the universe. And so all the blinky things around the universe were called Stars.  ### Physical Appearance - **Scales**: Pitch black with glowing spots - **Appearance**: Looks like the universe itself - **Glowing spots**: Seem to be "inside" the scales - **Demeanor**: Stern, righteous, less curious than Berry  ## Astaras Observatory Astara created [[Astaras Observatory]], a titanic city and magical town where few are allowed to live. There are stipends to study there (similar to CERN). The observatory is built with unique protection capabilities.  ### Astaras City - Small magical town - Few are allowed to live there - Stipends provided to study - Like a research center (CERN-like) - Built with unique protection capabilities - Built into/on top of a sanctuary  ## Personality  - **Stern**: More serious than her brother Berry - **Righteous**: Very moral and just - **Less curious**: More wary than Berry - **Protective**: Created a protected place for learning  ## Relationships  - **[[Berry]]**: Younger brother, fellow Titanic Dragon - **[[The Forge Titan]]**: Creator - **[[Astaras Observatory]]**: Her creation/city  ## Legacy  - Named all the stars in the universe - Created a center for learning and observation - One of only two Titanic Dragons in existence - Her appearance inspired the naming of celestial bodies  ## Notes  - One of the two [[Titanic dragons]] (along with Berry) - Created directly by The Forge Titan, not by gods - Has lived for thousands of years - Currently maintains Astaras Observatory  Tags: #character #dragon #titanic-dragon #astara #mother-of-stars
